title: InsideEVs: All the non-Tesla EVs that can use Tesla Superchargers in 2026 (updated 2026-03-20)
notes: Full list of eligible brands/models. Explicitly excludes the Ford Focus Electric and the first-generation Fiat 500e; Stellantis entries are Charger Daytona, Wagoneer S, Recon, Fiat 500e (not first generation). Fisker, VinFast, Rimac and Lordstown are not on the list (and not mentioned).
